title: Charge from I-t graph
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the total charge Q as the area under the I-t curve from t=0 to t=6.0 ms, obtaining 0.5 C.

title: Magnetic field expression
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the given formula B = kI/r to find the magnetic field inside the solenoid at the specified time.

title: Magnetic flux calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the magnetic flux Φ through one turn as Φ = B * πa², yielding 6.28×10⁻⁸ Wb (or equivalent).

title: Current at specified time
description: Important: The student must correctly read the current I from the I-t graph at t = 3.0 ms to use in the flux calculation.

title: Area interpretation error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates the area under the I-t graph (e.g., using wrong geometric formula or misreading axes).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Award if the student explicitly shows unit conversion (e.g., ms to s, cm to m) and maintains consistent SI units throughout.

title: Flux through N turns
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student mistakenly calculates the total flux through all N turns instead of for one single turn as requested.
